title: Document.cookie does not seem to match major browsers
body:
The Document.cookie getter and setter text says to use the Document URL, both for the cookie-averse check and for getter / setting the cookies:
- https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-cookie

While implementing the cookie-averse check in WebKit, I noticed that WebKit does not use the Document URL for cookie getting / setting but rather has a concept of "Cookie URL". Blink has the same cookie URL concept it seems.

The Cookie URL is usually the same as the document URL except for iframes whose URL is:
- about:blank
- about:srcdoc
- empty

In such cases, the cookie URL is the owner document's cookie URL.

I wrote a quick test case for setting a cookie in a main frame and then retrieving the cookies in an about:blank subframe:
- http://jsbin.com/pevupiyoyu/1/edit?html,css,output

Based on my testing, the about:blank subframe returns the same cookies as the main frame's document in Firefox, Chrome and Safari. As far as I can tell, this does not match the spec as the frame document's URL is "about:blank". I think the iframe's document would even be recognized as cookie-averse as per the spec given its URL's scheme.

Am I missing something? or does the spec need to be updated to match browsers?
